business_objective: Coordinate room-reset work between event sessions and confirm readiness before the next session begins.

stakeholder_statements.text: Between sessions, the event coordinator creates a room turnover task and names the room.
The venue crew lead assigns the task to a crew member and records the setup items that must be completed.
I mark each setup item complete when the room has been reset.
Before the next session starts, the session host records whether the room is ready. If it is not ready, the host adds a reason.
The coordinator closes the turnover task only after the host records the room as ready. Catering orders are not handled here.

business_objective: Track company-item handover and workplace-access withdrawal during employee offboarding.

stakeholder_statements.text: When an employee's departure is confirmed, the offboarding coordinator opens a handover record and lists the company items expected back.
The departing employee should see the listed items and mark which ones they have handed over.
The asset custodian verifies each returned item and records any item that was not returned.
The access coordinator records when the employee's workplace access has been withdrawn.
The handover record may be closed only after every listed item has been verified or recorded as not returned, and workplace access has been withdrawn. Final pay calculations are outside this project.

business_objective: Track equipment faults, repairs, safety clearance, and return-to-service decisions.

stakeholder_statements.text: When equipment behaves abnormally, the operator reports the fault and marks the equipment unavailable for use.
The maintenance planner reviews the report, sets a priority, and assigns it to a maintenance technician. The priority choices have not been agreed.
The technician records the diagnosis and the work performed, then marks the repair complete.
If the fault is safety-related, a safety verifier must clear the equipment before it can return to service. We still need a rule for deciding which faults are safety-related.
For faults that are not safety-related, the planner may return the equipment to service after the repair is complete. Spare-part purchasing is handled elsewhere.

business_objective: Control research dataset access requests through completeness, sensitivity, ethics, security, and final-decision reviews.

stakeholder_statements.text: The researcher submits a data-access request with the intended research use and the requested dataset.
The data steward checks whether the request is complete and classifies the dataset's sensitivity. The required request fields and sensitivity categories are still undecided.
The ethics reviewer reviews every complete request before it goes to the data owner. Security review is only needed for requests involving sensitive data.
The security reviewer says every complete request must come through security review, even when the dataset is not sensitive. For sensitive data, the reviewer records any access conditions.

The data owner records the final decision after all required reviews are complete, and approved researchers receive access instructions. Nobody has decided who sends those instructions or how quickly they must be sent. The committee also spent several minutes debating whether the meeting room needs more plants.
